properties.description:
Hold a joint needs-analysis session for progressively creating and reviewing UI mockups in Review → Changes. Ask one question at a time. Keep a Markdown transcript containing each question and the user's answer word for word as the session progresses; link it to this task.

Establish the user's workflow, the distinction between mockup editing and application implementation, initial editing and component-reuse needs, what a change comparison should show, and how feedback, context, saving and revisions support iteration. Establish what the first version must enable for the user to review the editor inside itself. Carry forward the existing review/annotation needs without repeating that interview. Record open choices instead of assuming a complete editor design.
properties.title: Analyze UI-editor needs with the user
